entries.description: Created docs/planning/notes-driven-supported-library-surface.md to translate the audit decision ledger and coverage gate into explicit supported-surface definitions for grid/filter/query, combo/detail/popup, shell/dashboard/catalog, reports, and security UI.

Established dedicated contract-test homes under tests/Dabbler.Components.Tests and tests/Dabbler.Reports.Blazor.Tests, added baseline smoke tests and READMEs, and added both projects to Dabbler.Platform.sln.

Updated src/Libs/README.md plus the Dabbler.Components and Dabbler.Reports.Blazor READMEs so they lead with the retained notes-driven contract and describe non-core or retirement-candidate surfaces accordingly.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln successfully after fixing the initial smoke-test harness issues; the new Dabbler.Components and Dabbler.Reports.Blazor contract-test homes both passed their baseline tests alongside the existing suite.
Sent the Session 1 spec excerpt, changed-file contents, and successful build/test summary to the external session verifier and saved the raw review output.
Ran a second external verification round with stricter ASCII verdict formatting so the verification result is machine-readable without altering the raw first-round review.
